## What changed

Describe the behavior and affected finding codes.

## Why

Describe the observable false-green or false-positive case.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a fixture or test
- [ ] Definite failures and heuristic warnings remain separate
- [ ] Bundled `dist/` output is updated
- [ ] Stable CLI, Action, config, finding-code, and Evidence Bundle v1 interfaces remain compatible
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were checked against `docs/THREAT_MODEL.md`
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, private CI logs, test names, or proprietary repository data
